expected_findings.root_cause: The missing or invalid CA bundle path check in cert_verify emits warnings.warn instead of raising OSError, so the failure no longer stops the request.
expected_findings.failure_path: A user passes verify="/etc/ssl/missing.pem" (or certifi returns an empty path); only a warning is emitted and execution continues to configure the connection with a nonexistent bundle, producing a later, misleading SSL or TypeError at connect time instead of the clear OSError.
